newsitem.title: USA: Genentech advances to Phase III trials.
newsitem.headline: Genentech advances to Phase III trials.

text.p: Genentech Inc said on Tuesday that it will advance its study of Nerve Growth Factor in diabetic peripheral neuropathy to Phase III trials.
Genentech also said in a statement that its majority stockholder, Roche Holding Ltd, exercised its option to develop Nerve Growth Factor outside the U.S.
As a result, Genentech said it will record contract revenues of $28.4 million in the third quarter of 1996.
Phase III trials are scheduled to begin by the end of the year with results available in 1998.

The study of Nerve Growth Factor just completed Phase II trials of 250 patients at 15 sites in the U.S. The trial showed Nerve Growth Factor significantly improved neurological function and the sensations of cooling detection and of heat measured as pain by well accepted neurological function tests.

Nerve Growth Factor is one of a family of natural human proteins known to stimulate the growth and survival of neurons in the nervous system. About eight million diagnosed diabetics in the United States, of whom 20 percent have symptomatic peripheral neuropathy.
